question: Approve DRC-4589 as delivered: three inks split onto label, value and absence roles?

artifacts.summary: GO. Six of seven criteria reproduced from their own Verified by clauses against the merged head, every falsifier aimed correctly redding, and AC-7 settled by a live drive on a board started from the reviewed tree after the reviewer rejected one already running that served a different tree. Review found a real defect this branch created - a withheld scope title resolving the value ink, byte-identical to a published one - which was fixed by restoring the rail override's colour, reversing a 2026-09-17 ruling whose premise DRC-4597 had changed. That reversal was verified twice independently, by the FO applying the ruling literally and by the reviewer re-deriving it. AC-3's wording was amended from a rule count to the rendered property, because the criterion as written was satisfied exactly by the defect.
